Upon your arrival, a key and magnetic card to open the barrier will be given to you free of charge. You must return it to us upon departure, otherwise a $50 fee will apply. Children can enjoy activities like treasure hunts or have fun in our various attractions, while adults can relax and enjoy their getaway or take part in gatherings, kayaking, beach walks, and much more.
